ideas.title: The Scale of Tax Fraud in the US
ideas.description: Investigate the scale of tax fraud in the US, focusing on a recent case of a Minnesota man accused of tax evasion.
questions: What is the extent of tax fraud in the US?
How can tax evasion be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the larger issue of tax fraud in the US and potential solutions to prevent it.

ideas.title: Data Breach Investigation

questions: How can similar breaches be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the causes and implications of the data breach and potential solutions to prevent similar breaches.
